subject: Use world-ground coordinates for elevated domino effects
description: Old schema-12 representative `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_linux2/Profile_002/Savegame_042/replay-004-session-0001.jsonl.zst` diverged after frame 7130 when flying Soldier185 failed to domino-hit upright Soldier182. Original `RHElementActor::ApplyDominoEffect` reads both actors through literal `GetPositionGround()` and the flyer's `GetIncrement().x/y`; `GetPositionGround()` is exactly world `GetPosition().x/y` (`original-code/RHelementactor.cpp:318-376`; `original-code/RHElement.h:322`). At the boundary, Soldier185's post-step world position was `(1003.323059,1682.814941,84.732353)` and Soldier182 was `(993,1673.863647,89.863663)`: world-ground delta `(-10.323059,-8.951294)` has squared distance about `186.69 < 225` and positive forward dot, so Original launches the concussion-3 `ReceiveHitDamage` element. Rust instead measured projected map positions `(1003.323059,1598.082642)` and `(993,1584)`, producing delta `(-10.323059,-14.082642)` and squared distance about `304.88 > 225`; it also projected the world flight Y increment by subtracting elevation increment before the forward test. The missing Original visibility query from Civilian108 to the newly hit Soldier182, and the Soldier182-184 alert/AI differences, were downstream consequences. Commit `9704d0beff6e66600dc4c4b10895bd4af361530c` now passes literal world X/Y positions and world X/Y flight increments to the domino sweep. The elevated regression proves admission with world Y delta `-9` where projected map Y would be `-16`, while the existing flat-flight cases remain unchanged; all six `domino_` tests pass. A fresh optimized runner matches the representative and adjacent same-save replay-003 through exact EOF. This is distinct from Task80, which corrected the owner-slot timing of flight and domino work but did not change its coordinate space.
